title: decode.rs strips CRLF with per-byte Vec::push() before base64 decode
description: decode.rs lines 63-73: CRLF stripping allocates a Vec<u8> with capacity=body_bytes.len() and pushes one byte at a time in a loop. For large base64 bodies (e.g. 1 MB attachment) this is a 1 MB allocation even before base64 decoding. The base64 crate's decode_engine() already accepts any Iterator<Item=u8>, so the CRLF-stripped iterator can be passed directly via base64::read::DecoderReader or by using decode_engine_slice with a filtered input. Alternatively, since MIME base64 is already line-wrapped at 76 chars, a two-stage approach (strip then decode) with a reusable buffer avoids the full-body copy.
